reserveReview.rationale: Pleasing Gold materials describe PGOLD as one fine troy ounce of 99.99% LBMA-standard physical gold and describe physical redemption through the issuer platform. The reviewed materials do not identify a dated independent reserve report, current gold quantity reconciliation, or the custody provider.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pleasing Gold product and token-feature disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The physical-gold reserve category is identified, but current reserve quantities, independent assurance, custody provider, segregation, and redemption liquidity are not independently evidenced.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Physical gold is an exogenous commodity reserve rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.

providers.name: Pleasing Gold issuer and undisclosed gold custodian

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer describes physical gold backing and redemption but does not disclose the vault or custodian, account segregation, bankruptcy treatment, rehypothecation terms, or current reserve evidence.
